name: Dramatic Deep Dive
description: Full-Kanto Deep Dive 0.6 preview with automatically enabled animated Pokemon Stadium 2 models for nearby visible underwater wildlife. Existing Crystal 251 DSM4 caches are consumed directly; Crystal 251 + Dramaless/Dramatic Shape can bootstrap a missing cache, and Battle Art can remain the active renderer while borrowing the compatible StadiumRig backend from Dramaless. Includes smooth underwater orientation, Pokédex-based compressed physical scale, morphology correction, source animation/material effects, distance-limited LOD and automatic 2D fallback.
